evidence.supports: June invalidity motion, direction to prepare July resolution and curative amendment within 180 days; not independently a fixed 180-day pause.
evidence.quote:
(1) Declare the Center Township Zoning Ordinance, to the extent that it excludes

data centers and power generation plant/systems as uses the township, to be

substantively invalid;

(2) Authorize and direct the Township Solicitor to prepare a Resolution making

specific finding setting forth the declared invalidity of the Zoning Ordinance,

to be enacted by the Township at its July 8, 2026, regular meeting; and

(3) Authorize and direct the Township Planning Commission, with the input of

the Code Officer and the Solicitor, to prepare and submit a curative

amendment to the Board of Supervisors, so that the curative amendment is

adopted by the Board of Supervisors within 180 days of this Motion.

Pringle seconded the motion. Motion carried.

A July 31, 2026 Butler Eagle roundup of Butler County municipalities independently confirms Center Township (along with Adams Township) 'went as far as enacting 180-day moratoriums on data centers and related developments.'
